Screen Replacement

Same day service

Water Damage Repair

Dropped in water? Our board-level repair specialists clean, diagnose and restore water damaged devices.

Board-level expertise

Chip-level service

Getting your device repaired is easy. Here's what happens from start to finish.

  1. 01

    Walk In or Call

    Visit our shop or call us to describe the issue. We'll give you a quick quote on the spot.

  2. 02

    Free Diagnosis

    We repair your device using quality parts with precision — most done within 1–2 hours.

    Quality Check

    Device is fully tested before handover. We walk you through everything we fixed.
